canonical_source.behavior: The AIMWWeb Logs & Error Center ClearFilters action resets the current search, level, from-date, and to-date filters without mutating log data.

laravel_adaptation.search_contract: The generic React search query parameter is normalized by AdminOperationsController from search to the existing q filter before OperationsControlPlaneService::logs reads persisted tenant logs.
laravel_adaptation.clear_semantics: The real Clear filters control performs a tenant-qualified navigation to the same logs workspace with no query/filter state, causing React state reset and an authoritative unfiltered reread through FrontendContext api.logs.

runtime_path: auth + tenant.context activate the requested tenant and workspace permission enforcement requires operations.manage plus diagnostics.view
React logs workspace reads FrontendContext api.logs
AdminOperationsController normalizes search to q and authorizes operations.manage
OperationsControlPlaneService::logs reads persisted operation_logs constrained to TenantContext tenant_id
user activates canonical Clear filters control AIMW-CONT-83908F2D7C
browser navigates to /tenants/{active-tenant}/module/logs with no filter query or in-memory filter state
tenant context and logs API are reread authoritatively without filters
unfiltered persisted rows for only the active tenant render; no sample rows are synthesized

tenant_isolation.proof: Acceptance persists two Alpha operation_logs rows and one Beta row. Alpha filtered and unfiltered API reads return only Alpha rows; a direct Alpha request using Beta's correlation_id returns zero rows. Tenant A direct access to Tenant B workspace/API fails 404.
tenant_isolation.active_tenant_binding: Clear target is derived only from FrontendContext context.tenant.slug and URL encoded.
tenant_isolation.direct_id_idor: No log/resource direct-ID route is introduced. Workspace and API expose only the tenant path parameter; persisted rows are constrained by TenantContext tenant_id.

semantics.wordpress_runtime: not applicable to this local persisted logs UI-state reset operation

real search alias filtering through search to q

canonical_denominator.note: This is the isolated contribution of exactly this one operation against the latest generated reconciliation authority. Parallel unmerged worker PRs are intentionally not folded into these generated-authority counts.

terminality.basis: The real production logs workspace exposes the exact canonical Clear filters control; filtered and unfiltered reads use real persisted tenant-scoped operation_logs; clearing resets adapted filter state and causes an authoritative unfiltered reread; authorization and Tenant A/B isolation are proven; focused tests and the implementation exact head passed all authoritative repository gates.
